# AI Dev Knowledge

> A Korean-language knowledge base of practical tips, updates and workflows for building apps, web services and games with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT/OpenAI and Grok Bot. Each entry is a short, hand-written Korean summary with a source link, so it stays usable even if the original post disappears.

- Language: entries and summaries are in Korean; index pages have Korean and English intros.
- Audience: developers (client and server), artists, game designers and QA who build apps, web and games with AI.
- Entry format: a `## title` heading followed by `- 도구:` (tool), `- 날짜:` (date), `- 요약:` (summary) and `- 출처:` (source) lines. Recent entries also have `- 작성자:` (author handle), `- 원문 링크:` (linked external URL or none) and `- 아카이브:` (web.archive.org snapshot or none). In bookmarks.md, entries are `### title` under `## category` headings.
- Updates: new entries are added to the monthly file about twice a day (around 00:00 and 12:00 KST).
- Topic pages under topics/ are generated by scripts/build-index.py and list entries newest first, linking to each entry's heading.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/README.md): Overview, audience, entry format, FAQ and how to regenerate the indexes
- [Topic index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/README.md): All topic pages with entry counts

## Topics by tool

- [Claude Code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/claude-code.md): Entries about Anthropic's Claude Code
- [Codex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/codex.md): Entries about OpenAI Codex (CLI, app and cloud)
- [Cursor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/cursor.md): Entries about the Cursor AI code editor
- [ChatGPT / OpenAI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/chatgpt.md): Entries about ChatGPT and OpenAI models and APIs
- [Grok Bot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/grok-bot.md): Entries about running and configuring Grok Bot

## Topics by theme

- [MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/mcp.md): Model Context Protocol servers, clients and security
- [Agents & Skills](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/agents-skills.md): Coding agents, subagents, harnesses and SKILL.md skills
- [Game Dev & Unity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/game-unity.md): Building games with AI, including Unity, Godot and Unreal
- [Art, 3D & Video](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kugorang/ai-dev-knowledge/main/topics/art.md): Images, sprites, pixel art, 3D, VFX and video creation
